# COMPOUND PHYSICAL PARAMETERS

| COMPOUND NUMBER | LOT NUMBER |
|-----------------|------------|
| A30 | |

## PHYSICAL STATE
Clear Colorless liquid

## pH
The pH of a 50% concentration of A30 in (52.6% dioxane)/water was calculated to be 6.0 according to the extrapolation procedures by Dr. P. D. Schickedantz, Lorillard Research Center Accession Number 1662, Reference OR 83-81.

## SOLUBILITY
(See SOP for Biological Solutions)

### ORAL
Reference OR 100-32

.5g A30 soluble in .5 mL corn oil at room temperature.

### ACUTE CARDIOVASCULAR
(See SOP for Determination of Solubility of Materials for Acute Cardiovascular and Respiratory Effects Study in Beagle Dogs)

Reference OR 100-32

.2 mg A30 soluble in .5 mL 10% propylene glycol solution at 38°C. Add A30 to warm (38°C) propylene glycol; add warm water to make 10% propylene glycol solution.

## STORAGE RECOMMENDATIONS
Refrigerate in amber bottle at no more than 8°C.

user_question: How does this Compound Physical Parameters form (00836816) differ from the Addendum II form (00837285) in terms of transactional purpose and data organization?
answer: The Compound Physical Parameters form provides primary documentation of a compound's key properties for routine handling and biological testing, with an emphasis on practical parameters like solubility and storage conditions organized by application, while the Addendum II form serves as a supplementary document focused on advanced chemical characterization with systematic organization around reactivity and analysis parameters; the first establishes foundational handling protocols for laboratory operations, while the second provides extended characterization data for specialized applications
